sentences.text: The Home Loan Agreement copy says the borrower must pay a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding on pre-payment or foreclosure.

The RBI pre-payment-charge directions cited in the record are no longer in force on 2026-11-23, because the 2025 directions were withdrawn effective 2025-11-28 and the 2014 circular was withdrawn effective 2026-01-01.

The only potentially current RBI findings in the record are the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 provisions on prepayment charges, but their applicability is marked unknown for this case because the needed facility, rate type, and sanction-date details are not resolved in the findings.
So, based on the provided findings, compliance with RBI’s current rules cannot be confirmed or rejected for this clause.

missing.searched: Checked the code-verified RBI findings for current prepayment-charge rules applicable to a Tier 3 UCB home loan to an individual for a non-business purpose; the findings mark the relevant UCB provisions as applicability unknown because facility, rate_type, and sanction_date are not resolved.
